findings.title: Exchange and answering transmission
findings.claim: At the exploratory edge, concealed suggestion and familiar human uptake may form an exchange circuit in which reception produces answering action and renewed transmission.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies concealment and familiar-human carriers, 114:4 supplies attributed exchange and equivalence imagery, and 114:5 supplies hidden self-talk and an action-origin that can return the received thought outward.
findings.reader_payoff: The source pair can be seen as counterpart channels in a loop of uptake and response, adding reciprocity to the ordinary source-to-recipient picture.
findings.containment: The ordinary one-directional source reading remains live. This is an exploratory exchange analogy based on the non-dominant mapped branch of 114:4; it is not a lexical gloss of شر or الجنة.

epistemic.reason: The outlier has exact coordinates and focus return, but both exchange branches and the supporting mapped roots are unresolved legacy HFT nominations, and the trace itself marks the analogy exploratory.

findings.title: Hidden gestation and visible emergence
findings.claim: The pair can also carry a lifecycle image: an influence gestates and grows unseen, then emerges in visible human action or in a human carrier.
findings.mechanism: The focus hidden-being form carries the supplied fetus and plant-growth branches, while the opening nurture occurrence and 114:5 inward/action-origin occurrences provide development and emergence triggers that return through the human focus noun.
findings.reader_payoff: A source that appears already formed can also be perceived as something incubated under concealment before becoming visible conduct or a new carrier.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading names two formed source classes. This is an exploratory lifecycle metaphor; the fetus, plant-growth, and mapped nurture branches are not lexical definitions of الجنة.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus facets and context coordinates are supplied, but the mapped growth root and supporting context branches are unresolved legacy HFT nominations and the outlier is marked exploratory.

findings.title: A human-seeming reflected source
findings.claim: At the exploratory edge, the human-seeming source may be a reflected or projected self-image through which hidden inner speech is misrecognized as another's voice.
findings.mechanism: The focus supplies the small human image or reflection and hidden-heart branches, while 114:5 supplies hidden self-talk and the attributed action-origin that anchors the apparent other back in an inward source.
findings.reader_payoff: The human pole can be perceived as an image that looks external while carrying a hidden inner voice, opening a psychological analogy for misrecognized influence.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of a human source outside the recipient remains live. This is an exploratory optical-psychological analogy, not the direct referent of الناس, and the mapped action-origin and self-talk branches are attributed.

epistemic.reason: The focus reflection facet and exact 114:5 coordinates are supplied, but the action-origin and self-talk branches are unresolved legacy HFT nominations and the outlier is marked exploratory.
